name: Gmail
description: Google's own hosted Gmail MCP server — read and compose mail. Needs a Google Cloud project and an OAuth access token; MultiZone sends the token you paste as an Authorization header.
prerequisites: A Google Cloud project with the Gmail API (gmail.googleapis.com) and the Gmail MCP API (gmailmcp.googleapis.com) enabled
An OAuth consent screen carrying the gmail.readonly and gmail.compose scopes
The gcloud CLI, to mint an access token: gcloud auth print-access-token

headers.label: OAuth access token
headers.description: Paste the token itself, not the word Bearer — MultiZone adds that. Google access tokens are short-lived (about an hour), so this needs re-pasting until signed-in connectors land in 1.2.

name: GitHub
description: GitHub's hosted MCP server — issues, pull requests, code search and repository contents, as your account sees them.
prerequisites: A GitHub personal access token with the scopes for what you want to reach (repo for private repositories)

headers.label: Personal access token
headers.description: A fine-grained or classic PAT. Paste the token; MultiZone adds the Bearer prefix.

name: Context7
description: Up-to-date documentation for libraries and frameworks, fetched per version rather than from the model's memory. Works without a key; a free key raises the rate limit.

headers.label: API key
headers.description: Optional — leave blank to use the anonymous rate limit.

name: Tavily search
description: Tavily's search and extract tools as an MCP server. Once connected, its search tool is available to any zone you enable it for — the supported way to add a paid search provider.
prerequisites: Node 18 or newer, so that npx can run

name: Filesystem
description: The reference MCP server for reading and writing files under directories you name. MultiZone has its own file tools; this is here as the smallest working example of a stdio server.
prerequisites: Node 18 or newer, so that npx can run
Add the directories it may touch to the end of the command — it can reach nothing else

name: Playwright browser
description: Drives a real browser — navigate, click, fill forms, read the accessibility tree. Downloads a browser on first run.
prerequisites: Node 18 or newer, so that npx can run
